question: In a certain code language, “SUIT” is written as “SITU”, and “CUTE” is written as “CTEU”. How will “WASH” be written in that language?
solution:
In the above question, alphabets interchange their positions.

1st alphabet remains at the same place.

2nd alphabet is at last.

3rd alphabet is at second position.

4th alphabet is at third position.

“SUIT” is written as “SITU”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64b0a8056b446cc0bcde4ddf2c9352f6ccc420fca53a9bbdf3123f7cfd520e21.png] 

And,

“CUTE” is written as “CTEU”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8df67b89d89f040a67be32096504f5cd0bcd7d8380c40f201fe6eeafbe8337f.png]

“WASH” be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b754687b9144770ff1bcd9aecc229091342e9458dc4b469a592a81ea800126e4.png]
